id.description: The ID of this User Node

user_id.description: The ID of the User that owns this User Node

label.description: The user friendly label for this User Node

type.description: The type of this User Node (defaults to "Other")

data.description: User defined data for this User Node

time_created.description: The time this User Node was created

time_updated.description: The last time this User Node was edited

time_deleted.description: When this User Node was soft deleted, or null if active

id.description: The ID of this User Edge

user_id.description: The ID of the User that owns this User Edge

label.description: The user friendly label for this User Edge

data.description: User defined data for this User Edge

subject_ref.description: The subject as a Translator ref (e.g. a CURIE), or null when the subject is a User Node

subject_user_node_id.description: The subject as a User Node ID, or null when the subject is a Translator ref

object_ref.description: The object as a Translator ref (e.g. a CURIE), or null when the object is a User Node

object_user_node_id.description: The object as a User Node ID, or null when the object is a Translator ref

time_created.description: The time this User Edge was created

time_updated.description: The last time this User Edge was edited

time_deleted.description: When this User Edge was soft deleted, or null if active

UserEdge.description: A user defined edge. Its subject and object are each either a Translator ref or one of the User's User Nodes; endpoints are set when the edge is created and cannot be changed.

label.description: The label for the User Node

type.description: The type for the User Node. Defaults to "Other"

data.description: User defined data for the User Node

CreateUserEdgeRequest.description: A new User Edge. Each endpoint is given exactly once, as a Translator ref or as a User Node ID.

label.description: The label for the User Edge

data.description: User defined data for the User Edge

subject_ref.description: The subject as a Translator ref. Give exactly one of subject_ref and subject_user_node_id

subject_user_node_id.description: The subject as an active User Node owned by the current User. Give exactly one of subject_ref and subject_user_node_id

object_ref.description: The object as a Translator ref. Give exactly one of object_ref and object_user_node_id

object_user_node_id.description: The object as an active User Node owned by the current User. Give exactly one of object_ref and object_user_node_id

UpdateUserNodeRequest.description: A partial update of a User Node; only the fields present are changed.

data.description: New user defined data, replacing the existing data

UpdateUserEdgeRequest.description: A partial update of a User Edge; only the fields present are changed. Endpoints cannot be changed, and sending any endpoint field is a 400.

data.description: New user defined data, replacing the existing data
